title: Combined runtime supervisor
responsibility: Own the lifecycle of the two processes that make up a running Kiln: validate the project and settings, choose and prove a port, start the browser launcher with a private stdin pipe so it cannot consume the operator's typing, wait for identity-confirmed readiness, start Pi in the outer project root with the terminal inherited, begin or resume the recorded planning session, and on exit or signal stop both process trees within bounded grace periods and remove only what this invocation created.
notes: ⚠️ ONE TERMINAL, TWO PROCESSES, AND ONLY ONE MAY READ IT. If the background launcher inherits stdin it will eat the authentication answer or the first planning message. ⚠️ PI'S WORKING DIRECTORY IS THE OUTER PROJECT, never the tool clone, and the self-hosting checkout — where those two are the same directory — is refused unless explicitly opted into. F122 (2026-09-16): CI run 35097288227, at commit b8b09b2, windows-latest node 22, natural mode. The launch preflight timed out on the primed WMI route at 10,009.7 ms with no rows, and the supervisor refused with process-table-not-primed before either Pi or the launcher was spawned. ACC-0081's 10-second preflight bound held as specified, so the criterion outcome stands. This is the second primed-route timeout event that EVD-0109's recorded rule names: WMI is withdrawn as the Windows identity strategy and replaced wholesale by a WMI-free identity format, delivered as a separate correction. The later green run 35141902017 does not cancel it. Interactive session recovery for ACC-0103 is paused until the replacement is green. F130 (2026-09-17, watch item): CI run 35214314607 at commit a957d43, windows-latest node 22, interrupt evidence. One WMI-free identity read for the launcher tree started 5,384 ms into the shutdown with a 2,316 ms allowance and did not answer (process-table-timeout); the other seven Windows reads in that cell took 362 to 530 ms. With 298 ms left no further read was started, the launcher descendant was recorded unverified, and the run refused with shutdown-not-observed at 7,706 of 8,000 ms. The deadline and fail-closed behaviour held. The failed job was not rerun and production shutdown behaviour is unchanged. If another Windows CI run times out on a WMI-free identity read, phase instrumentation of identity reads (spawn, first byte, exit) follows. F130 recurred in the same run on windows-latest node 24: five consecutive WMI-free reads ran to the full 10,000 ms bound (four real-reader tests and the natural evidence preflight, which refused the launch before spawning), while later reads in that cell took 245 to 638 ms. Under the recorded rule, O6 phase instrumentation is active. F133 (2026-09-17, watch item): CI run 35250274939 at commit 3a2a830, windows-latest node 22. The unit test 'a descendant that survives its parent is escalated, and the tree is not reported stopped' reported no surviving descendant where it expected one. It injects its processes but uses real timers (200 ms grace, 150 ms hard wait, a 30 ms parent exit), and the commit under test changed only the guard-file module. Not investigated. If it recurs, that test's real-time dependency is replaced with deterministic clock controls; its waits are not increased.
